grh_b3f0c38d6573dda541bc.title: Love Letters
paragraphs: During the war, Captain Alan Quinton writes deeply personal love letters for his less articulate friend Roger Morland to a young woman named Victoria. Alan falls in love with the unseen recipient through his own words, but Roger returns home, marries Victoria, and later tells her that the letters were never his. After Roger is found stabbed to death, Alan comes home convinced that Victoria killed him and eventually meets an amnesiac young woman known as Singleton, not realizing she is Victoria herself. The two fall in love while Alan struggles with the knowledge of her past. Cleared of the murder and reunited with the man who truly wrote the letters she loved, Victoria and Alan can finally claim the relationship that began before they ever met.

grh_b3bca520b7a56c8ef484.title: Fields Of Corn
paragraphs: World War I veteran Jim Brown is terrified that his only son Howard will volunteer for the Air Corps and endure the horrors that killed Jim's friends and left him with years of nightmares. He even offers Dr. Christian a thousand dollars to declare the healthy young man medically unfit, but the doctor refuses. Howard agrees to stay on the farm for his father's sake, despite wanting to serve and despite the support of the girl he plans to marry. During a violent night storm, Jim is shaken by what he describes as a dream or vision in which the corn outside seems to become the comrades who died beside him in the last war, calling on him not to make their sacrifice meaningless. By morning Jim has changed his mind and gives Howard his blessing to do what he believes is his duty.

grh_b304c2941e290bfa61f9.title: Little Sweetheart
paragraphs: Polly Palmer returns to Rivers End and throws herself into raising money for Dr. Christian's children's clinic, rekindling the childhood hero-worship she has felt for him all her life. She breaks her engagement to Lee Morgan and mistakes Dr. Christian's gratitude and affection for romantic love, leaving the embarrassed doctor afraid that correcting her will humiliate her. Lee follows her home but, instead of forcing the issue, helps make the hospital campaign a success. Once the work is finished, Polly recognizes that Dr. Christian is the ideal she has always adored but Lee is the man who truly needs and belongs with her; she chooses Lee and asks Dr. Christian to attend their wedding.

grh_b3b4c81b2899262cfb9c.title: Whoopee
paragraphs: Sally Morgan is expected to marry Sheriff Bob but is in love with a young man raised as an Indian, while hypochondriac Henry Williams becomes her accidental accomplice when she runs away from the wedding. Their flight creates a comic manhunt and even gets Henry mistaken for a gang leader. Black Eagle finally reveals that Sally's beloved was actually born to white parents and adopted after his mother died, removing the racial barrier Sally feared. grh_b3019ed3c49d0c27cafe.title: House Is Haunted
paragraphs: After cheating an Australian bushman out of a valuable diamond and killing him, Alec Riverton returns home haunted by the dead man’s warning that he will die on the third day. The victim’s voice begins speaking through strangers around Alec, including a cab driver, waiter and finally his doctor, driving him deeper into terror. On the third day Alec panics when the doctor approaches with a sedative, sees the murdered man in his place and collapses dead as the prophecy appears to complete itself.

grh_b35ce7d96407f588a7ed.title: Smilin' Through
paragraphs: Elderly John Carteret raises his niece Kathleen while remaining haunted by the memory of his beloved Moonyeen, who was killed on their wedding day by jealous Jeremiah Wayne.
